title: Camping, step by step
summary: The five-minute loop and every roll in it
lede: Camping is a loop of five-minute steps. Each pass checks for an ambush at the top of an hour, then lets the guard wander. This is how the original does it.

items.title: Status and rings.
items.text: The display updates and Regeneration Rings are checked.

items.title: Ambush roll.
items.text: Only if the hour changed since the last step: a 1 in 64 chance.

items.title: On an ambush,
items.text: the loop ends and combat starts. If you posted a guard, the sleepers are woken first; with no guard, they are not.

items.title: Otherwise
items.text: five minutes pass and the sky refreshes.

items.title: The guard wanders.
items.text: If you posted one, a 1 in 4 chance to take a step in a random compass direction, on screen and onto legal ground.

blocks.text: The game stops once it reaches the target hour, so the final hour change is never tested. Resting H hours in the original gives **H − 1** ambush rolls. A 9-hour rest gets 8 rolls: about an 11.8% chance of at least one ambush.

blocks.label: Redux differs
blocks.text: Redux rests for the full time you chose, so a rest can cross one more hour and face one more roll.

items: Poisoned members are remembered but are not put to sleep.
A guard does not change the ambush chance. It changes who is awake when the ambush arrives.
No poison tick, meal or starvation check runs inside the loop.

blocks.text: A full rest of more than five requested hours, with the cooldown at zero, heals the party and may bring the Wanderer. The details are in [Levelling and the Wanderer](/original/how/levelling/). An ambush skips all of it.
